text:
maya: Hey team :wave: I opened a docs PR to fix a dashboard/trace naming mismatch that's causing a bunch of cost/latency tiles to render as 0. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — would love quick reviews from @jonathan and @alex; repro steps below.

jonathan: thanks maya — can you paste the exact metric name + the query you're running so I can repro locally? :eyes:

maya: repro snippet: the dashboard is querying "redwood.console.kvcache.latency_ms" but the runtime emits "redwood.console.kv_cache.latency_ms". Example query we run in the UI:```
SELECT avg(value) FROM metrics WHERE name = "redwood.console.kvcache.latency_ms" AND time > now() - 5m
```
This returns empty; switching to `redwood.console.kv_cache.latency_ms` returns the expected data.

alex: ah yep, I see the old name leaked into two places: the conceptual docs dashboard JSON and the embed snippet in /console/observability/dashboard-embed.md. Quick diff idea:
```diff
- "redwood.console.kvcache.latency_ms"
+ "redwood.console.kv_cache.latency_ms"
```
Also: the Python tracing example in the same page is missing the explicit trace_key parameter which we've standardized — that'll confuse customers who copy/paste.

docs-bot: link-checker: failed on PR 412 — 1 broken internal link: /sdk/python/trace-hooks -> 404. Suggested target: /sdk/python/tracing (found in site map). Logs: link-checker v2.3.1 

maya: thanks — i'll push two commits: one to replace metric names across docs and embed JSON, another to fix the python snippet and the broken link. Proposed Python snippet tweak:```python
from redwood import Tracer
tracer = Tracer(trace_key="rdw-trace")
with tracer.span("kvcache-query"):
    client.query("...")
```
That adds the explicit param and matches the console examples.

support: heads-up — this is hitting a handful of customer dashboards on Dedicated. Please add a short migration note and post in #dedicated-migrations when the PR merges so CS can schedule the rollout. Also check for any saved views that reference the old metric key. :exclamation:

jonathan: will review the PR today. For the migration note, suggest adding a short section under /console/observability/migrations.md with a one-liner sed/jq replacement command, e.g.:
```bash
# replace metric key in exported dashboard JSON files
sed -i 's/redwood.console.kvcache.latency_ms/redwood.console.kv_cache.latency_ms/g' *.dashboard.json
```
That should make post-merge customer ops easier. :thumbsup:

maya: perfect — assigning reviewers: @jonathan for docs + migration note, @alex for the embed JSON/console example. I'll push fixes shortly and ping here when CI is green. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
